tools.name: depth_estimate
tools.description: Estimate per-pixel depth from a single image using GLPN-KITTI. Returns a grayscale PNG depth map where brighter pixels are closer to the camera. Useful as a ControlNet conditioning hint, for parallax effects, or for analysing scene structure before compositing.

dest.description: Output PNG path for the depth map (optional — a temp file is used if omitted)

tools.name: depth_is_available
tools.description: Return true if the depth plugin's required packages (torch, transformers, numpy) are installed
